{{Short description|Finnish mathematician (1925–2020)}}
[[File:Olli-Lehto-1962.jpg|thumb|right|Olli Lehto with a computer in 1962.]]
'''Olli Erkki Lehto''' (30 May 1925 in [[Helsinki]] — 31 December 2020<ref>{{cite web |url=https://yle.fi/uutiset/3-11722712|title=Akateemikko Olli Lehto on kuollut – hän tuli tunnetuksi erityisesti matemaattisten tieteiden edistäjänä|date=3 January 2021 }}</ref>) was a Finnish mathematician, specializing in [[geometric function theory]], and a [[Chancellor (education)|chancellor]] of the [[University of Helsinki]].<ref>{{MacTutor|id=Lehto|title=Olli Erkki Lehto}}</ref>

Lehto earned his PhD in 1949 from the University of Helsinki under [[Rolf Nevanlinna]] with thesis ''Anwendung orthogonaler Systeme auf gewisse funktionentheoretische Extremal- und Abbildungsprobleme''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=18690}}</ref> At the University of Helsinki, Lehto was from 1961 to 1988 a professor, from 1978 the dean of science, from 1983 the [[Rector (academic)|rector]], and from 1988 to 1993 the chancellor.

From 1983 to 1990 he was Secretary of the [[International Mathematical Union]]. In 1962 he became a member of the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]] (Suomalainen Tiedeakatemia). <ref>[http://www.acadsci.fi/jasenet/varsinaiset_jasenet.htm List of members of the Finnish Academy of Science and Letters] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150808063536/http://www.acadsci.fi/jasenet/varsinaiset_jasenet.htm |date=2015-08-08 }}</ref> In 1968 he was elected member of the [[Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters]] and in 1988 he became honorary member of the same society.<ref>[http://scientiarum.fi/eng/members/ Members of the Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters]</ref> He was a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] from 1986.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26849/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26861|title=Utenlandske medlemmer|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=no|access-date=27 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070715102608/http://www.dnva.no/c26849/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26861|archive-date=15 July 2007}}</ref> In 1975 he was given by the President of Finland the honorary title "Academician of Science" (Tieteen akateemikko). Lehto was the chief organizer of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM) in Helsinki in 1978 and an invited speaker of the ICM in Moscow in 1966 with lecture ''Quasiconformal mappings in the plane''. He was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].

In 2001 Lehto published a biography of his mentor Rolf Nevanlinna.<ref>{{cite book | last = Lehto | first = Olli | year = 2001 |title = Korkeat maailmat: Rolf Nevanlinnan elämä |publisher= [[Otava (publisher)|Otava]] |oclc= 58345155 |trans-title=High Worlds: The life of Rolf Nevanlinna |language = Finnish }}</ref>

* ''Univalent functions and Teichmüller Spaces.'' Springer, Graduate Texts in Mathematics, 1987.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Earle, Clifford J.|title=Review: ''Univalent functions and Teichmüller spaces'', by Olli Lehto|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. * {{cite book | last = Lehto | first = Olli | year = 2001 |title = Korkeat maailmat: Rolf Nevanlinnan elämä |publisher= [[Otava (publisher)|Otava]] |oclc= 58345155 |trans-title=High Worlds: The life of Rolf Nevanlinna |language = Finnish }}
